question: As a solo developer, what habit is compared to a carpenter re-measuring the wood before a cut, a driver buckling the seat belt, or a chef testing the food?
answer: Checking in the code (to source control) before going back to sleep.
support: a good programmer will check-in the code before he goes back to sleep

question: I have a command-line tool that only accepts an input file and an output file as arguments, not stdin and stdout. How can I put it in the middle of a shell pipeline?
answer: Create two named pipes with mkfifo (IF, OF), run 'bad_tool IF OF', feed IF from earlier commands and read OF in later ones, then rm them.
support: mkfifo IF mkfifo OF ... bad_tool IF OF

question: In PostgreSQL, how do I create a unique index directly on a CASE WHEN expression without getting a syntax error?
answer: Wrap the CASE expression in an extra set of parentheses: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX test_index ON test ((CASE WHEN i=1 THEN j END));
support: You need to add extra parentheses around the CASE expression

question: When running dotnet test in a GitHub Actions workflow, which runner OS already has dotnet installed so I don't need an extra setup step?
answer: windows-latest has dotnet pre-installed; macOS and Ubuntu runners need an extra step using the actions/setup-dotnet action.
support: dotnet is pre-installed on windows machine but is not pre-installed on macos and ubuntu

question: Is it supported to configure BFD on a virtual-template or dialer interface on Cisco IOS-XE 3S?
answer: No. Older releases like IOS-XE 3S wrongly allowed the configuration, but BFD on virtual-template and dialer interfaces is not supported and is deactivated on newer versions.
support: BFD functionality on virtual-template and dialer interfaces is not supported

question: If a Windows service runs as the Network Service account and creates a new event log source or registry key, what do you have to do for it to work?
answer: Explicitly grant the Network Service account the rights needed to create the event log source or registry key.
support: you would need to explicit grant the rights to the network service account

question: What is the difference between setting MySQL max_allowed_packet with SET GLOBAL on the command line versus in the config file?
answer: The config file accepts shorthand like 100M (binary prefixes), while a SET GLOBAL value is lost when the server restarts.
support: the set global will be lost on server restart

question: Why is it considered a code smell to have a CompanyDao use an EmployeeDao internally?
answer: It introduces undesirable coupling, can leave one DAO subordinated to the other, and sets up a possible circular dependency.
support: it would introduce undesirable coupling

question: ifconfig doesn't show my default gateway. Which command prints the routing table, including the gateway address, and is now the preferred tool?
answer: ip route show, which prints a line like 'default via 212.13.197.1 dev eth0'.
support: ip route show ... default via 212.13.197.1 dev eth0

question: After renaming my Windows server, the Oracle listener won't start. How do I find the file to edit and what do I change?
answer: Run lsnrctl status to find the listener.ora path, change the HOST entry in it to the new host name, then restart the listener.
support: Change the host there and restart the listener.

question: How can I reboot a group of servers one at a time with an Ansible ad-hoc command, waiting for each to be fully booted before the next?
answer: ansible -i inventory nodes --forks 1 -m reboot
support: ansible -i inventory nodes --forks 1 -m reboot

question: A site-to-site VPN tunnel on a Cisco ASA shows as up but passes no traffic. Which ASA software version resolved this for one user?
answer: Upgrading the ASA image to 8.6.1(5), which fixes bug CSCtq57752.

question: What are the two weaknesses of using a contract to make a large company's promise believable?
answer: Courts cannot undo a disclosure (compensation may be insufficient), and courts cannot deal with breaches that are undetectable.
support: The courts can't deal with things that are undetectable

question: How can I secure Remote Desktop access to a PC without exposing it directly to the internet, using PuTTY?
answer: Tunnel the RDP session through an SSH tunnel in PuTTY, via a Linux virtual machine running an SSH server.
support: I tunnel my RDP session through the SSH tunnel to ensure its security.

question: How can I wrap a text file to about 80 characters per line without breaking words mid-word and send it straight to the printer?
answer: fold -s myfile.txt | lpr

question: Can 32-bit SQL Server 2012 use AWE to access more than 4 GB of memory?
answer: No. 32-bit AWE was removed from the database engine starting with SQL Server 2012; use 64-bit SQL Server 2012 instead.
support: 32-bit AWE was removed from the database engine starting with SQL Server 2012

question: What rule of thumb is suggested for how many roles a single VM or physical host should serve in an infrastructure?
answer: Avoid using one logical piece of kit for more than one thing; a VM host should only be a VM host.
support: avoid using one bit of logical kit ... for more than one thing

question: When a router connects to a layer-3 switch that has SVIs for several VLANs, how should the link between them be set up for OSPF?
answer: As a point-to-point routed link: use no switchport on the layer-3 switch port and give it a /30 or /31 address.
support: use no switchport on the layer-3 switch port

question: Even when SPF, DKIM and DMARC all pass, why can attacker@example.com still pose as goodguy@example.com in an email's From header?
answer: DMARC only aligns the domain part of the From address, not the full address, so a different user at the same domain passes.
support: this will only align the domain part but not the actually full address
